body: Forward test of the promise-tracker credibility method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.62 (naive base rate 0.50) that: HCLTech FY27 company-level constant-currency revenue growth is ≥3.25% (midpoint of its 2.5–4% guide). Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (13/15-Oct-2026): FY27 company guide 2.5–4% cc (incl. 87 bps inorganic), Services 3–4% (62 bps inorganic); top end trimmed to narrow the band; EBIT 17.5–18.5%. CEO: 'For Services, we feel confident to be slightly above the midpoint'; mega-deal adds no revenue until Q1 FY28; 3 of top-20 clients ramping down already 'factored in'. Q3 is 'our strongest quarter'. History: FY25 guided 3.5–5%, delivered ~4.7% (upper half). Reasoning: HCL guides conservatively and has usually landed in the upper half; mgmt explicitly says above-midpoint for Services. Acquisitions add mechanical growth. Risk: software-products seasonality and client ramp-downs. Resolution: YES if HCLTech's reported FY27 company revenue growth in constant currency (Q4 FY27 press release) is ≥3.25%. Source: HCLTech Q4 FY27 results press release / investor release. Resolve by 2027-04-30; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: Coin-flip for landing above a guidance midpoint absent a track record.
data.resolution_rule: YES if HCLTech's reported FY27 company revenue growth in constant currency (Q4 FY27 press release) is ≥3.25%.

title: Paper call: HCLTech FY27 company-level constant-currency revenue growth is ≥3.25% (midpoint of its 2.5–4% guide)

body: Promise-credibility forward test, Nov-2026 cohort (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Krsnaa Diagnostics (KRSNAA). Probability 0.34 (naive sector base rate 0.35) that: Krsnaa Diagnostics (KRSNAA) FY27 cash-based revenue >= Rs 380 cr (95% of Rs 400 cr). Probabilities set only by the pre-registered rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/forward_test_2026-11/prereg.md s4): p0 = 0.354 (pooled all cohort + T&D companies, group 'revenue' (sector pool n=7 < 8), n=79); SAC -0.132 x w 0.130 (N=3) -> P_cred = 0.34. Evidence: call of 2026-11-03: "By the end of FY '27, we expect our cash-based revenues to contribute almost 40% to 45% ... aggregating to approximately INR400 crores for the year" (Q2FY27). Resolution: YES if company-reported FY27 cash-based (retail + cash PPP) revenue >= Rs 380 cr. Source: company Q3/Q4 FY27 filings, presentations and call transcripts (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-30; score Brier of P_cred vs P_base (prereg s5).

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.354 (pooled all cohort + T&D companies, group 'revenue' (sector pool n=7 < 8), n=79); SAC -0.132 x w 0.130 (N=3) -> P_cred = 0.34
data.adjustment_rule: P_cred = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC, 0.05, 0.95); SAC = mean(y - p0(group)) over the company's resolved past promises (strict: delivered=1, else 0); N<3 -> P_cred = p0. P_base = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = leave-one-out strict delivery rate of Healthcare peers in group 'revenue' (pooled all cohort + T&D companies, group 'revenue' (sector pool n=7 < 8), n=79). No company-specific information.
